clues.text: Featuring a 208-foot lift hill and reaching top speeds of 77 mph, this steel coaster delivers high-speed thrills with zero inversions.
Designed and built by Swiss manufacturer Intamin, this hypercoaster made its debut in 2000.
This coaster operates along the Connecticut River at an amusement park located in Agawam, Massachusetts.
This coaster and Cedar Point's Millennium Force held the top two spots in the annual Golden Ticket Awards poll every year from 2001 to 2015.
The coaster's title honors DC Comics' iconic hero who saves cities from villains like Lex Luthor, paired with two words denoting it as an amusement park attraction.

evidence.quote: Superman The Ride (formerly Bizarro and Superman – Ride of Steel) is a steel roller coaster at Six Flags New England in Agawam, Massachusetts, United States.
Superman The Ride, along with Millennium Force, held the top two spots in the Golden Ticket Awards poll every year from 2001 to 2015.
It was themed to Superman saving a city from Lex Luthor's Lex Bots who are causing chaos with an anti-gravity ray.
